author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu marks the return of Star Wars to the big screen, the culmination of a journey that began when we met these now iconic characters six years ago. Tested visited the production, where director #JonFavreau walked Adam Savage through practical sets and Adam took a LOT of photos.
title: Adam Savage Freaks Out on #StarWars Set

author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
The Savage Industries apron is made to survive Adam Savage, but sometimes even "Adam tough" isn't enough. In this case, a customer's tape measure kept in the apron's front pocket ground against a worktable until the repeated friction created a sizable hole. Unable to find someone nearby to fix it, Sascha emailed Tested director of commerce Tom to see if he could help. SURPRISE, Sascha! And ... don't mind that HUGE mistake Adam made during the repair ... he fixed it.

Note: Mafia Bags (https://mafiabags.com/) performs warranty repairs on Savage Industries products, not Adam (usually).
